visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-width page-opening banner with a background image and an overlaid text panel (optional eyebrow tagline, H1 heading, body copy, CTA)
visualCharacteristics.layout: First row is the image, rendered full-bleed with reduced opacity and a bottom gradient fade; last row is the text, absolutely positioned over the image, vertically centred and left-aligned.
behavior: Two pictures: first is the light-theme image, second the dark-theme image; only the one matching the current theme is shown.
No picture: the block gets the `no-image` class automatically and the text is shown centred in normal flow.
A paragraph placed before the H1 is styled as the uppercase eyebrow tagline (only when the block contains an H1).
Body paragraphs are hidden below 600px viewport width.

contentPattern.structure: row 1 = one image (optionally a second row with a second image for the dark theme); last row = text cell with an optional tagline paragraph, an H1 heading, optional body paragraph(s) and an optional CTA link

rows.name: image-dark
rows.note: Only add when a separate dark-theme image is wanted; any second picture triggers the light/dark swap.

rows.name: text
rows.content: tagline p (before H1), H1, p, CTA link

notes: The tagline and `hero-text` decoration only run when the heading is an H1. Other heading levels render, but get no tagline styling.
Videos are not supported; use a still image (for example the video poster).

usage: Use once at the top of a page for the main promotional banner. Author the promo copy as real text, not as text baked into an image.
reuseGuidance: Use the plain hero for photo banners. The rust/gold/ink options are solid brand-colour backgrounds, mainly for heroes with no image. Do not add a second image unless it is a dark-theme alternate.
